sources.prompt: Create a completely NEW production 2D modular arm sprite sheet for the tactical anime ranger in the reference. Reference is STYLE and COSTUME only. Correct human anatomy and natural cloth, not tubes, not inflated folds. True transparent background, portrait canvas, exactly TWO columns and THREE rows with generous clear gutters, SIX isolated pieces, no labels, no text, no body, no gun. TOP LEFT: right upper arm sleeve, rounded shoulder cap at top and elbow at bottom, athletic adult proportions, broad deltoid tapering to elbow, olive uniform with one small tan blank patch and tiny cyan tab on outer upper arm. TOP RIGHT: left upper arm sleeve, same proportions, no patch. MIDDLE LEFT: right forearm sleeve from rounded elbow overlap at top to narrow open black cuff at bottom. MIDDLE RIGHT: left forearm sleeve matching. Sleeves are straight-ish in their local bone frame, about 2.2 times as long as wide, few broad intentional folds, NOT numerous puffy wrinkled lumps. Both elbow ends have about 15% smoothly painted overlap for skeletal animation, open sleeve cuffs have short black undersleeves to hide the glove wrists. BOTTOM LEFT: realistic RIGHT hand in tan/charcoal tactical glove, seen from rear three-quarter, gripping an invisible vertical pistol grip: wrist enters from lower left, knuckle block centered, three fingers curl round far side, index extends right along an invisible trigger guard, thumb wraps opposite side. BOTTOM RIGHT: realistic LEFT support hand in same glove, wrist enters from lower left, palm upward, four fingers curled upward on viewer-facing side around an invisible horizontal rifle handguard; thumb hooks over its opposite side. True empty transparent slot where the gun will fit. Gloves are compact human adult hands, not giant gauntlets, with five fingers total each. Each piece isolated within its own cell. Keep reference olive green, tan, charcoal and subtle cyan, clean confident black line art, flat two-tone cel shadows, simple large readable shapes, NO painted rim light, NO gradients, NO glow, NO 3D rendering, NO background.

sources.prompt: Create a new transparent 2D game sprite asset: TWO isolated tactical gloved hands side by side, no arms, no body, no weapons, no text, no grid. Match the reference's clean confident anime line art, olive-tan and charcoal tactical materials, simple two-tone cel shading, no glow. Crucial anatomy: BOTH WRISTS ENTER VERTICALLY FROM THE BOTTOM CENTER OF THEIR RESPECTIVE HAND. Both hands upright with knuckles above the wrist, not lying sideways. Left half: RIGHT trigger hand holding an invisible upright pistol grip. Back of hand faces camera in rear three-quarter view. Wrist centered at bottom, thumb wraps left far side; middle/ring/little fingers curl to the right around invisible grip; index finger points to the RIGHT across top of trigger guard. Palm/knuckle mass centered directly above the wrist, index tip extends upper right. RIGHT half: LEFT support hand cupping an invisible horizontal rifle handguard from below. Wrist centered at bottom directly below palm, palm faces up and slightly toward viewer, four compact fingers curl upward and toward viewer over near side of the invisible handguard, thumb wraps far side at left. Natural human adult five-finger anatomy, functional firearm grip. Short black glove cuffs at bottom, tan fabric backs and charcoal palm pads, three or four broad folds only, no excessive padding. Equal-sized hands, generous transparent margins and a clear gap between the two hands. Both show a natural wrist entering from six o'clock, never from nine o'clock. Full hand silhouettes and cuffs contained in canvas. Genuine transparent background.
